name: Introduction to Hermes Agent
beschreibung: What an AI agent is, how to give it tasks in plain language, how to check the result yourself and where its limits are. Everyone works with Hermes in their own isolated Agent PC – with a free model. As a 2-hour course or on your own in self-study mode.
zielgruppe: People without prior knowledge who want to try out AI agents
voraussetzungen: Computer with Linux, Windows or macOS, at least 8 GB RAM and 40 GB free disk space
Bony's Agents (for courses over the internet: with the Bony Network turned on)
your own free account with the model provider (Nous or OpenRouter)
kosten: none – Hermes runs with a free model
lernziele: explain in your own words what an AI agent is and why it works in an Agent PC
start Hermes in the Agent PC and give it a task in plain language
have Hermes create and read files and check the result yourself
have Hermes research something on the internet and look at the sources critically
name limits and risks (wrong answers, costs, privacy) and know what not to give an AI
reset an Agent PC or create it anew from a template
